typedef Step = Future<void> Function();
Future<void> inOrderSteps(Iterable<Step> items, {required String reason}) async { for (final item in items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await client.put(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await audit.save(item);
} }

Future<void> use() async {
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: "Each update reads the previous write");
}
